title: Removal and Disposal of Medical Material for the US Army Medical Material Center, Korea (USAMMC-K), Camp Carroll
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M MRCO PACIFIC
detail_text: The Medical Readiness Contracting Office – Pacific intends to issue a within scope contract modification contract W81K0225PA001. The services that are being performed are Removal and Disposal of Medical Material for the US Army Medical Material Center, Korea (USAMMC-K), Camp Carroll. The anticipated period of performance of this modification is 10 March - 31 December 2026. The anticipated date for contract modification is March 2026. The purpose of this modification is to increase CLIN 1001. This announcement fulfills the synopsis requirements under FAR 5.201 and 5.203.
